pairs.title: Swiss franc in euros
pairs.description: How many euros CHF 1 buys. A rising number means a stronger Swiss franc.
pairs.source: Derived from Federal Reserve H.10 series DEXSZUS and DEXUSEU (FRED) on each trading day: € per CHF 1 = (US$ per CHF 1) ÷ (US$ per €1).

pairs.title: Swiss franc in US dollars
pairs.description: How many US dollars CHF 1 buys. A rising number means a stronger Swiss franc.
pairs.source: Federal Reserve H.10 (FRED series DEXSZUS) · noon buying rate, New York; 1 ÷ the published CHF per US$.
